subject.title: [Feature]: Add stateless bounded research responses mode

question: Should `/v1/responses` expose a permanent research-specific vendor mode, or should bounded stateless execution be modeled through a generic request-policy/profile seam?
rationale: Both choices create a new public gateway contract and determine whether research policy belongs in core or in a reusable execution-profile abstraction; source inspection cannot infer that product intent safely.

options.title: Design a generic bounded profile
options.body: Define a reusable request-level profile for ephemeral session, prompt, storage, and internal-tool policy, then express research as one validated profile if needed.

options.title: Sponsor the narrow research mode
options.body: Accept `openclaw.mode: "research"` as an intentional public specialization and require provider-parity, upgrade, validation, documentation, and live accounting proof.

options.title: Decline a new core surface
options.body: Keep the existing stateless Responses contract and require callers or an external integration to own specialized research orchestration.

recommendation.title: Design a generic bounded profile
recommendation.body: Define a reusable request-level profile for ephemeral session, prompt, storage, and internal-tool policy, then express research as one validated profile if needed.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice concerns permanent core gateway and product API direction rather than a mechanical implementation detail.
